items.remaining_entry_review: Host.call still uses a bounded synchronous250ms timeout; this alone does not prove periodic250ms stalls. Bind real mode calls/delayed peer and metadata reads to the current main loop before changing waits or per-burst reuse.

items.remaining_entry_review: Row comparison and opacity inspection remain. Inspect final code and actually changing rows before generation/region opacity reuse or fewer passes. No second local copy routine or coverage algorithm.

items.achieved_in_86: Bounded positive cache, exact path/size/container keys, original load priority and alpha128 pixels preserved.
items.remaining_entry_review: Failed loads return before a positive entry; Entry.paint calls rect per visible pixel. Count real reads/decodes and final commands including existing coalescing before bounded retry/span work. Retain replacement/hotplug/update invalidation.

items.achieved_in_86: Topology, point mapping, rescue and shared signed geometry already use the R4GFX Rust owner. Desktop adapts local types/memory.
items.remaining_entry_review: Only truly identical remaining CPU/native/capture rotation/point operations justify extraction. Raster center/ceil and damage outer rounding remain distinct contracts; no second topology or per-pixel dispatch.

items.achieved_in_86: Slot Empty/Native/Cpu resource state, separate retained Device/operational flags and actual close ACK; primary Empty/Native/Retained already typed. Shared stepwise Slot.close and native output/worker close/join owners.
items.remaining_entry_review: Do not replace the correct enums or recreate independent option fields. Only demonstrated residual duplicate safe drain/finalization justifies work; different waiting/parking deadlines and physical ACK mechanisms are not interchangeable boilerplate.

items.achieved_in_86: One bounded typed recover/read/create/parse adapter for all four display documents, transactional replacement, shared save owner and current color reread/merge.
items.remaining_entry_review: Desktop load unification is fulfilled in86. Review only identical components in the four canonical R4GFX parsers, preserving strict field/error/serial/header/receiver/comma contracts; reject a generic engine with more special cases than benefit.

limits: Local KVM4 software and actual native provider/model scope only. No renewed Windows, physical AMD/NVIDIA/output/encoder or cursor-latency qualification. Counts and completed copies are not display FPS/physical visibility.

The verified integer Rust target remains selected because of the proven pinned-toolchain SIMD aggregate-copy fault. The common memory primitives use integer x86-64 operations, preserve DF=0 and admit no new ISA requirement.
RAM comparison is the actual comparable global physical pressure gauge with the same transient reader, not VM alias sums, artifact file size or an isolated SNES owner allocator gauge.
